verdict.rationale: Runpod documents pre-configured Docker templates, including an official PyTorch template, that replace installing PyTorch, JupyterLab and dependencies by hand. A community user confirms launching templates "in a few clicks," and vLLM is available as a pre-built Serverless worker. missing for 10: explicit evidence of CUDA and ComfyUI templates, and a documented vLLM Pod template rather than only a Serverless worker.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch from pre-built ML templates (PyTorch, CUDA, vLLM, ComfyUI) instead of assembling an environment from scratch

citations.quote: Instead of installing PyTorch, configuring JupyterLab, and setting up all dependencies yourself, you can select an official Runpod PyTorch template and have everything ready to go instantly.
